answer: Bind each agent to an opal escrow of 600 POA locked for 12 epochs and require it to answer unannounced verifier probes within an 80-millisecond echo window seeded from its public key and the epoch beacon. A jade audit slashes the full bond if two identities share timing jitter or miss three probes. Running 200 sybils forces an attacker to lock 120,000 POA and provision 200 isolated low-latency hosts, making mass cloning unprofitable.
